annual_discount_text: Core: a 25% savings with annual billing; Advanced: a 6% savings with annual billing
notes: Only one page view was provided. Core and Advanced prices are per license starting prices from the FAQ, marked as estimates that may exclude VAT/GST and promotional discounts. Localized prices in AUD, CAD, EUR and GBP also appear for Core and Advanced but were not recorded: Core A$154.99/month or A$1,499.88/year, C$144.99/month or C$1,199.88/year, €120.99/month or €1,088.88/year, £94.99/month or £959.88/year; Advanced A$189.99/month or A$2,159.88/year, C$179.99/month or C$2,039.88/year, €148.21/month or €1,693.88/year, £130.00/month or £1,499.88/year. Advanced Plus pricing is custom, via demo or sales quote. Free trials for Core and Advanced exist but no free plan is listed. InMail 50/month is a feature, not a price. Team seat management and centralized billing are features; no credits are mentioned.
